fields.label: Use
fields.description: Uncheck to drop this cost from this specific job without deleting the row - the row stays visible so it's clear it was deliberately excluded, not forgotten.

fields.label: Calculated Cost
fields.description: The actual cost used for this row - either the normal calculated figure, or your Override below when one is switched on. Always the real number that feeds the total, never stale.

fields.label: Source
fields.description: At-a-glance flag so you don't have to check every row's Override checkbox individually - Calculated means the normal formula ran; Manual Override means someone replaced it with their own figure for this job.

fields.label: Override
fields.description: Tick to replace this row's cost entirely with your own figure below, including a figure of exactly 0 - useful for Artwork, Packing (box capacity depends on paper weight and which of several box sizes is used - not something a single formula should guess), or any line that occasionally needs a one-off different number. Left unticked, the normal calculation always applies, no matter what's typed below.

fields.label: Override Amount
fields.description: Only used when 'Override This Cost' above is ticked.

fields.label: Why This Override?
fields.description: A short note for whoever looks at this estimate later - e.g. 'Mofeed's real number for this paper weight/box size, our generic carton formula doesn't fit yet'. Optional, but a real help six months from now.
